# `aitbc sync status`

Show synchronization status, block height, peer count, and hub divergence.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc sync status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to check (defaults to node's configured chain) |
| `--hub-url` | text | — | no | Hub RPC URL to compare against (defaults to HUB_RPC_URL or node-url) |
| `--gap-threshold` | integer | `5` | no | Height gap considered a divergence (default: 5) |
| `--alert` | flag | `false` | no | Exit non-zero on divergence or unreachable hub |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc sync status
```
